frozen_target: Reduce verified Lean-kernel instruction cost without semantic regression

residual_before.statement: Dominant recursor prefix is a 3-argument lambda chain; key_env/prune_env_cold is the largest measured internal cost basin

candidate_actions.proposal: Exploit existing key_env/prune_env machinery directly with a narrowly-scoped reuse fast path for repeated identical body/env demand
candidate_actions.risk: May repeat prior memoization failures if key identity is unstable

candidate_actions.proposal: Measure demand-mask distribution for the 95,606 key_env calls in the dominant recursor-prefix subfamily
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Determines whether pruning repeatedly computes a small recurring support pattern that can be compiled

candidate_actions.proposal: Measure cold-vs-hit/repeated-key structure for key_env/prune_env calls using structural rather than pointer identity
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Separates reuse opportunity from irreducible unique pruning work

candidate_actions.proposal: Partition final-eval body shape after the three-prefix lambda chain
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Tests whether pruning cost can be bypassed for bodies with simple or closed demand

candidate_actions.proposal: Represent lambda application by an environment-demand signature instead of repeated key_env traversal
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Could eliminate repeated support discovery if probes establish stable demand equivalence

candidate_actions.proposal: Producer-side compile of body support mask attached to lambda/closure creation
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Moves demand computation from hot consumer path to producer path
candidate_actions.gate: Requires evidence that masks are stable and producer-side metadata cost amortizes

candidate_actions.proposal: Change residual policy to require proposal portfolios and matched value-per-cost ranking before selecting a next experiment
candidate_actions.target_rationale: Prevents single-path fixation and makes the developmental controller itself closer to the recursive optimizer specification
candidate_actions.gate: Evaluate separately from kernel optimization outcome

selection_rule: Prefer the lowest-level action with high expected target value per cost; because prior generic key_env/prune memoization attempts exist and may have failed, first discriminate demand-mask and structural-repeat geometry before a new fast path
selection_reason: Two complementary probes can be collected in one instrumentation pass and directly determine whether PUSH_A or a representation change is licensed
next_generation_rule: If repeated small support masks dominate, propose compiled/support-mask candidates; if structural key repetition dominates, propose reuse candidates; if neither, partition final body shape; if all are diffuse, reframe away from repeated key_env traversal. Do not hard-code a v17 mechanism before the v16 verifier result.
